Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for TMC ACTREC AC Technician Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for the AC Technician post?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the AC Technician post at TMC ACTREC is scheduled for 28 September 2026. Candidates should ensure they reach the venue on time on this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the minimum qualification required for the AC Technician position?
faq.answer: The minimum qualification required is SSC passed with 2 years of ITI/NCTVT in RAC (Refrigeration and Air conditioning) from a government-recognized institute.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any experience required for the AC Technician role?
faq.answer: Yes, a minimum of 2 years of experience in handling air conditioning and refrigeration systems is required for the AC Technician position.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the AC Technician post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the AC Technician post is 33 years. Age relaxation may be considered based on experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the AC Technician position?
faq.answer: The salary offered for the AC Technician position ranges from Rs. 26,210 to Rs. 35,000 per month.

faq.question: Q6. How many vacancies are available for the AC Technician post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the AC Technician post at TMC ACTREC.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: There is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: You should carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies of educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and category certificate (if applicable), along with recent passport-size photographs.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for this recruitment is a Walk-in Interview.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the walk-in interview venue?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at Advanced Centre for Treatment, Research and Education in Cancer (TMC ACTREC), Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra, Pincode: 410210.
